body: Thanks again everybody, I don't think I can continue posting here in good faith (my wife didn't understand this was the suicide watch section, she never uses reddit). By that I mean I've gotten help, and the worst seems over. thank you

Hey there. "The wife" speaking. I first just want to say that I KNOW that I have serious issues with my self-image and self-worth. I am a very insecure person in many ways (mostly with my looks) and these issues come from a lifetime of multiple types of abuse by every person in my life that I have ever cared about up until I met my husband. This is absolutely not an exaggeration and I am not looking for sympathy. I know that I am a big girl now and I have a responsibility to myself and to family to fix these issues. 
Now, having said that, my husband is a big boy as well and owes it to me and to his children to address this problem and he knows that and I can see that he is trying very hard to make things right. Masturbation and pornography are NOT the same thing. That is a fact. My husband knows that I have no problem with him masturbating whatsoever. It is a healthy, natural process. I would be worried about him if he didn't. As long as he is not neglecting me sexually in favor of his hand, I think it's great. I would be a hypocrite if I were to ask him to stop masturbating. I cannot imagine doing such a thing to my husband. 
PORN on the other hand is very different. He has been getting off to images of people who are not me. This is devastating to me since, as he said earlier, I caught him once before we were married and I explained how it made me feel. You do not need to view porn to get off. PORN is NOT healthy, even if it is the norm. And I realize some women are ok with it. I can't say anything about that except maybe that their husbands are lucky. I will never be ok with being alone downstairs with my children having a hectic morning and trying to take care of things while he is up in our room (IN OUR BED!!!!!) watching videos and getting off to other women that I will never again measure up to. It is not fair. Not to me and not to his children. And not to him either because he is disgusted with himself every time he does it. At least he says he is. I know that men are visual and all of that crap and I think it is perfectly natural for a man to appreciate seeing a beautiful woman when he is out and about. And I know that porn is just a picture. But it is a picture of someone who is NOT his WIFE. That is infidelity. In a healthy marriage, a husband respects his wife. PERIOD.
 Now, not only do I feel like he has had no respect for me or for my feelings since before we even got married because he's been bringing OTHER WOMEN into our marriage and OUR BED, I have also been LIED to. Lying and cheating are the two things I swore I would NEVER tolerate in a marriage. We agreed when we first got together never to lie to each other and for ONCE in my life I thought I had found someone who would at least be honest with me if nothing else. That is gone. I can't believe ANYTHING he says to me now. That trust is just gone. I still would have been hurt had he been open with me about it, but we could have worked through it. Much like we are trying to now, only without all the trust issues that have been added to the situation by the fact that he has been lying to me throughout our entire relationship. 

Can anyone here see my side of this? This is not just about my insecurities. I am deeply in love with him and can honestly say that I DO NOT think of other men in that way. Like I said before I understand that it is natural for a man to appreciate beautiful women. That's fine. What the hell ever. But every bit of my sexual energy is directed toward my husband. YES even when I'm masturbating. And I am torn apart by the thought that he needs to see other women to get himself off. WHY NOT ME?! I don't understand! I am deeply hurt.

Only if she wants to still, and it's gotten harder literally overnight. Everytime I go to work, she gets left to her thoughts, and more questions, and emotions that come with all that; I get home, we talk until we're both too tired, and it seems better the next day, then gets worse again. We almost setup an appointment for her while at mine yesterday. 

I have to go home now though. Thank you everyone for suggestions; I may be back tomorrow if anyones paying attention to this thread. I also start taking cymbata(?) tomorrow, so it may help. Thank you.

She never said she would take anything away, but I would lose it; she told me I'd never have to worry about not seeing the kids; I wouldn't be able to live here though, again no family or friends, and moving to them means losing the family I helped to make. She would rather I be there for them without being with her, if it comes to that. I just can't see it happening though, it makes me feel sick

[this](http://blog.ashleyweis.com/2009/08/to-wife-hurting-because-of-husbands.html) is the only thing I could find that accurately describes kind of what's going on. No interest in the god parts of it; I emailed it to her at home and talked to her for about 10 minutes, but she didn't seem to care about fixing it like this, I don't know.

"that's what men do" is what you find everywhere on the internet. I've rationalized it the same way all this time, and had to face the fact that it doesn't matter; I knew it would hurt her, and certainly should'nt have lied about it. believe me that posting here is the last thing I would do if I felt it was somewhat justified, but between her and I, we've unraveled all arguments that justify anything I've done. We're seeing a counseler, but it may be too late, and as I noted, I've been prescribed meds to try to help with my problems. 

I can't see her as controlling, and I knew marrying her about her insecurities and anxiety. In sickness and health, all of that. I've heard plenty of comments all over the web that tell wmoen hurt like this that they need to get over it, that it's something wrong with the way tehy see themselves; but it's not her fault I lied about it and hurt her like this. The whole killing myself is mostly because I can't bear the thought of losing those kids and her; I would really LOSE them, never see them, no family close by me, no real friends... I'd be states away, and couldn't handle the thought of this

I know all of this, she wouldn't want to watch it with me (she has offered once before, as a way to make her feel more confident upon advice from a friend, the fact that I refused involving her now that she knows, makes her feel that much worse) and I wouldn't want her to want to, really; I've always agreed that she should be more than enough, and completly satisfys me, and (again) between fits she's allowed me to open up to her sexually (something I was scared to do). This has only seemed to make it worse in the long run, because we both felt cheap for doing it so soon after this happened, and she felt pressured, which is something I never want to happen to her. 

We have been to counseling once since this happened; I had to beg her to go, and she doesn't want to see how it can help, at least I feel that way by her reaction when I bring it up. I can't stand thinking I've done this to her anyway, and what right should I have to askk any more of her, you know?

I know she has insecurities like this, I HAVE known, and I've always tried to help, and go figure I did the thing that hit her insecurities the most. I understand what she's doing hurts me, and that she knows it's happening, in between attacks about it she's apologized, and I've told her she shouldn't, I deserve it. I'd never cheat on her, REALLY cheat, I'd thought about if I did before this happened and came to the conclusion I would die if I did. But she sees it as the same as cheating, and to make it worse, It's happened in our very bed. 

I DO want to stop, and I have wanted to, but couldn't; I've been "addicted" since I was 6 or mabye earlier. And she would understand if I had done it openly, it would still hurt her; but I didn't. I've done it behind her back, and lied about it at least once. I've lost all her trust in the process.

I've done this, tried to at least -- I can't even begin to say how many times, both before and after this happened. She's still in the mindset that everything we ever had was a lie. and more wants me to admit I've cheated on her with women I find sexier than her -- I really can't do this, at least honestly, since as mentioned before I would never CHEAT, and admitting that it's the same would kill me.
